frequency.name: wordfreq
frequency.changes: Filtered and ranked by Vocnet: only one-token word forms of letters, combining marks, apostrophes, and periods are kept, and each is ranked by its Zipf value.
frequency.attribution: Word frequencies from wordfreq by Robyn Speer (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7199437), CC BY-SA 4.0. wordfreq contains data from SUBTLEX-US and SUBTLEX-UK by Marc Brysbaert et al., freely available at http://crr.ugent.be/programs-data/subtitle-frequencies; from OPUS OpenSubtitles 2018, originating from OpenSubtitles (http://www.opensubtitles.org/); from Google Books Ngrams (http://books.google.com/ngrams); and from the Leeds Internet Corpus, Wikipedia, and ParaCrawl.

cefr.name: CEFR-J Wordlist
cefr.license: Free for research and commercial use with citation; copyright Tono Laboratory, TUFS
cefr.changes: Filtered by Vocnet: parts of speech mapped onto Vocnet's, numbers, infinitive "to", and the inflected forms of be, do, and have dropped, spelling variants split, and the lowest level kept per lemma and part of speech.
cefr.attribution: The CEFR-J Wordlist Version 1.6. Compiled by Yukio Tono, Tokyo University of Foreign Studies. Retrieved from https://cefr-j.org/download.html on 2026-11-09.

cefr.name: Octanove Vocabulary Profile C1/C2
cefr.changes: Filtered by Vocnet: parts of speech mapped onto Vocnet's ("vern" read as verb), the unlabeled row dropped, the lowest level kept per lemma and part of speech, and CEFR-J levels taking precedence.
cefr.attribution: Octanove Vocabulary Profile C1/C2 (ver 1.0), created by Octanove Labs (http://www.octanove.com/), from Open Language Profiles (https://github.com/openlanguageprofiles/olp-en-cefrj), CC BY-SA 4.0.
